Jobs and Opportunities

  • Tramshed Creators Networking Event

    Tuesday 26 May, 6:00pm–9:00pm

    Join Artistic Director Luca Silvestrini and Executive Producer Caron Loudy from Luca Silvestrini’s Protein for an informal conversation about creating ambitious, community-focused dance projects in Greenwich and beyond. After the talk, the evening will continue as an informal networking space; an opportunity to meet fellow creatives, share ideas, and make new connections.

    more info

  • Woolwich Singers Concert

    Friday 22 May, 7:00pm

    Wake up to Spring 2026 with an evening of old and new songs performed live by Woolwich Singers at their regular home in the Tramshed. A Spring Concert dedicated to love.

    more info

  • BOXED IN

    Saturday 27 June, 11:00am & 2:00pm

    A quirky, thought-provoking exploration of the unspoken rules that shape our lives. Told through movement, visual storytelling, humour and a touch of chaos.

    more info

  • The Falcon's Last Flight

    This show has been rescheduled to 14 November 2026 due to an emergency.
    Further details and ticket link will be available soon.

    The Falcon’s Last Flight is a gripping new Tudor drama that imagines the final, forbidden meeting between King Henry VIII and Anne Boleyn on the eve of her execution.
